Using only the inline frozen sources on the board (source_contract, research_contract, data_quality, price_profile, initial_inspection, and the three per-symbol unadjusted close tables), produce qualitative findings on: (1) applicability constraints any executable close-momentum signal must respect on this sample — unadjusted CNY closes from a current non-vintage download, observed union of dates is not an exchange calendar so absences prove nothing, no filling, close-only jumps cannot identify corporate actions, all inputs at or before the signal close, execution no earlier than the next observed close, last-row signals have no execution observation; (2) source-supported motivations for at most ONE alternative specification relative to the baseline — weigh the observed cross-symbol one-observation return dispersion and volatility heterogeneity versus isolated large single-observation moves, and state which spec fields any motivation would touch (normalization and volatility window, absolute daily-return bound, lookback, direction) and what added parameter or eligibility exclusion each would require; (3) what evidence a later independent evaluation would need before any adoption, superiority or investment-benefit claim. Preserve the exploratory, unproven status of all hypotheses.
